newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to set up privatisation agency in February.
newsitem.headline: Poland to set up privatisation agency in February.

text.p: The Polish government is likely to set up the privatisation agency, envisaged by current the reorganisation of the cabinet ministries, in February, a deputy treasury minister said on Friday.
"The treasury ministry should finish work on the statutes of the agency in January and the government will approve them in February," Leszek Juchniewicz told a news briefing.
The agency, due to supervise technicalities of privatisation, is envisaged by the cabinet reform under which the privatisation ministry was replaced by a more powerful treasury ministry last year.

Juchniewicz said the agency would oversee flotations of state-owned enterprises and their sales to strategic investors, except for largest, strategic projects, which will be supervised by the treasury ministry itself.
He added the more than 40 privatisation projects, currently run by the treasury ministry, would be completed by the ministry.
"The agency will work on new projects," he said.
He said no decision had been taken so far on who would head the agency, an institution crucial for Poland's market reforms.
